entry.value: import knime.scripting.io as knio%%00010import pandas as pd%%00010import numpy as np%%00010from prophet import Prophet%%00010from statsmodels.tsa.api import Holt%%00010import lightgbm as lgb%%00010import xgboost as xgb%%00010from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error%%00010import logging%%00010%%00010logging.getLogger('cmdstanpy').setLevel(logging.ERROR)%%00010logging.getLogger('prophet').setLevel(logging.ERROR)%%00010%%00010df_all = knio.input_tables[0].to_pandas()%%00010%%00010horizon = 4%%00010forecasts_list = []%%00010metrics_list = []%%00010%%00010def create_lags(df, target_col, lags=[1, 2, 3, 6]):%%00010 for lag in lags:%%00010 df[f'lag_{lag}'] = df[target_col].shift(lag).bfill()%%00010 return df%%00010%%00010for label_name, df_group in df_all.groupby('ColumnNames'):%%00010 df_sorted = df_group.sort_values('mes').reset_index(drop=True).copy()%%00010 %%00010 y_raw = df_sorted['ColumnValues'].astype(float).values%%00010 dates = pd.to_datetime(df_sorted['mes'])%%00010 %%00010 #
